from pathlib import Path
folder=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689779/attempts/75b9ca6211d4403aafd75899a9af5d34/system/state/workspace/programs'); folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    colors=set(v for row in g for v in row)-{9}
    for c in colors:
        pts=[(r,j) for r,row in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==c]
        r0=min(r for r,j in pts); r1=max(r for r,j in pts); c0=min(j for r,j in pts); c1=max(j for r,j in pts)
        # Hollow rectangular outlines are filled by parity of their cavity width.
        w=c1-c0-1; h=r1-r0-1
        fill=7 if w%2==1 else 2
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for j in range(c0+1,c1):
                if g[r][j]==9: g[r][j]=fill
    return g
'''
(folder/'task-2af46b08.py').write_text(code)

 for i in range(r,r+h):grid[i][c]=col;grid[i][c+w-1]=col
